sources.name: GachaWiki Weiss dataset
sources.role: Weiss master catalog + official artwork URLs
sources.description: MIT-licensed English Weiss Schwarz dataset. Premium parallel printings such as SR, SP, SSP and SEC+ are stored as distinct card numbers and point to official Bushiroad artwork URLs.

sources.name: Bushiroad Weiss Schwarz
sources.description: Primary reference for products, card rules, reprint announcements and physical treatment changes. Used to validate collector-sensitive edition metadata.

sources.name: dragogodev/cgs Palworld mirror
sources.description: GitHub-hosted mirror of official Palworld card data, including BP01, Trial Deck printings, promos and official image URLs.

sources.name: Palworld Official Card Game
sources.description: Official source used to close the gap between the GitHub baseline and newly released ESS/promotional printings, and to keep announced future promos separate from released cards.

sources.name: Palworld Prices
sources.description: Free key-less JSON API over completed sales. BushiMetrics preserves confidence tiers, thin-sample qualifiers, sample size and evidence-page links; asking prices remain separate context.

sources.name: TCG API / TCGPlayer
sources.description: Daily Weiss market prices and 24h/7d/30d changes. Requires TCGAPI_KEY; missing price data never blocks the catalog and is never replaced with a retailer ask.

sources.name: Manual validated snapshots
sources.description: Versioned observations for selected cards when automated coverage is missing. Every override includes an as-of context and remains distinct from model fair value.

methodology.title: Investment Quality v0.4
methodology.description: The current model is deliberately transparent and heuristic until enough immutable daily snapshots exist for a walk-forward fitted model.

factors.name: Structural scarcity
factors.description: Rarity/treatment pressure; later versions will substitute empirical case/carton pull-rate evidence where available.

factors.name: IP / character strength
factors.description: Versioned franchise priors now; intended to evolve into cross-rarity character premiums and external fandom signals.

factors.name: Reprint durability
factors.description: How resistant the physical collectible is to identical future supply.

factors.name: Historical significance
factors.description: First-set, launch, prototype, early promo and event significance.

factors.name: Treatment premium
factors.description: Signature, serialized, hot-stamp and premium-art treatment.

factors.name: Liquidity
factors.description: Current price/sales proxy until sell-through/listing data coverage grows.

factors.name: Edition durability
factors.description: First edition / distinguishable reprint structure, only when verified.

methodology.fairValue: Fair Value is only calculated when an observed market price exists. It is a relative model estimate, not an appraisal or guaranteed future price.
methodology.backtest: Daily compact market snapshots are stored without future data. 30/90/180-day MAE and directional accuracy will only be shown after each horizon has genuinely elapsed.

model: Catalog identity, image source, observed market, store asks and model outputs are separate fields. Missing market data remains missing.
